{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Applications & Components → Comma → `uRebarEndMarker`
{{% /callout %}}

Places associative notes on the ends of visible reinforcement bars in a drawing — one note per end, independently switchable.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Note 1 / Note 2** | Turns the note on/off at each end of the bar, and which note file to use for it. |
| **Offset (dX/dY)** | Shared distance/perpendicular offset applied to both notes — the sign at each end is worked out automatically from the bar's own geometry. |
| **Delete existing** | Removes any end notes this plugin already placed before adding new ones, so re-running doesn't stack duplicates. |
| **Mirror** | *Auto* (recommended — reads the bar's own shape, safe for a mixed batch of straight and bent bars), *Same side*, or *Symmetric*. |
| **Place on hook tip** | On (default): on a bar end that has a hook, the note starts from the tip of the hook. Off: it starts from the end of the bar's main body, where the hook's bend begins. Ends without a hook are the same either way. The offsets and the side each note takes are always worked out from the main body, so switching this only moves the starting point. |
